recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-15728 unless a future terminology-service decision intentionally changes the $translate input parameter model.
issue_request: FHIR-15728 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 Vocabulary change request to add conceptMap and conceptMapVersion input parameters to ConceptMap $translate for type-level invocation, equivalent to the parameters available for $expand-style invocation.
initial_application: The Jira records the change as pre-applied in SVN r13316. Git commit 4a1dbf1a8cbd27ddd00b0e6343ad07d701436e8e preserves that application by adding translate.url, translate.conceptMap, and translate.conceptMapVersion rows to source/conceptmap/conceptmap-spreadsheet.xml; later source rework carried the parameters into the current OperationDefinition XML.
additional_context: ConceptMap is active in source/fhir.ini and its operation list references OperationDefinition/ConceptMap-translate. Current source/conceptmap/operationdefinition-ConceptMap-translate.xml is type-enabled and contains conceptMap as a 0..1 ConceptMap input and conceptMapVersion as a 0..1 string input, both scoped to type. Vocabulary Confluence minutes for 2018-03-08 corroborate that tracker 15728 was persuasive and pre-applied; searches found no conflicting later community decision.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The required parameters are already present in current build source, and an empty audit commit records that FHIR-15728 is reconciled as no-change.

related_jiras.note: Jira search returned this separate later $translate response-source issue, but it is in Resolved - change required status and concerns canonical versus URI response identification rather than type-level conceptMap inputs. It was not decided here.
